title: Leia George
text:
I am a Research Project Coordinator in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Health at The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, where I work with Drs. Nicholas Allan and Melanie Bozzay on NIH-funded research, including the Advanced Resilience and Coping Study (ARC; R01MH136286) and Anxiety Sensitivity Treatment to Reduce Anxiety in Alzheimer’s (ASTRA; R01AG077569). My broader research interests center on understanding the affective, cognitive, and interpersonal processes underlying psychopathology, with an emphasis on how these processes contribute to individual differences in psychological functioning and change. I hope to incorporate emerging methodological approaches such as ecological momentary assessment and wearable sensing technologies to examine these processes in the context of everyday life.
I earned my Master of Science in Medical Physiology and Biophysics from Case Western Reserve University and my bachelor’s degree from Baylor University.
Beyond research, I am passionate about mental health advocacy, social justice, and addressing structural barriers to equitable care. I value collaborative, accessible, and inclusive science that reflects the diversity of the populations it aims to serve. I am always happy to connect with fellow researchers and potential collaborators!
